summary: The exhaustive exec contract now covers command execution, file changes, todo lists, and fatal failure semantics on the real `mu exec --json` surface, while keeping one public turn per exec prompt.

checked.note: The public schema now includes explicit command_execution exit_code plus dedicated file_change and todo_list item variants.
Tool starts are normalized into command_execution, file_change, todo_list, or generic tool_call items instead of leaking raw tool event names.
Tool completions normalize exit_code, todo summaries, and file-change completion state into explicit public item payloads.
The processor keeps one public turn per exec prompt and emits top-level error + turn.failed on fatal assistant errors.
`mu exec --json` runs through the public processor and now throws on exec-path runtime failures so exit codes are machine-meaningful.
Foreground bash success results now preserve exitCode in tool details, enabling normalized command_execution exit_code on the real CLI path.
The exec CLI path exits cleanly after completion, making real CLI exit-code verification possible.
